title: ATTACHED FORM NO. 7 — Application for Reissuance of a Certificate of Educational Donation Career Experience Institution Certification
full_text:
ATTACHED FORM NO. 7 — Application for Reissuance of a Certificate of Educational Donation Career Experience Institution Certification
[Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act]
Mark the applicable checkbox [ ] with a check mark (√).

[OFFICE USE]
Receipt number: __________  Date received: __________  Processing period: 60 days

[APPLICANT]
Name of institution (organization): __________________
Business registration number or corporate registration number: __________________
Address/location: __________________  Telephone number: __________________
Name of representative: __________________  Telephone number: __________________
Name and position of person in charge: __________________  Telephone number: __________________

[GROUND FOR APPLICATION]
[ ] Loss     [ ] Damage     [ ] Change

Reason for change: __________________________________________________________

[CHANGES]
| Before change | After change |
|---------------|--------------|
|               |              |
(Additional blank entries may be used for changed information.)

APPLICATION
Pursuant to Article 5 of the Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act, I hereby apply for reissuance of the certificate of educational donation career experience institution certification.

Year: ____  Month: ____  Day: ____
Applicant: __________________ (signature or seal)
To: Minister of Education

[ATTACHMENTS]
1. One original certificate (not required if the certificate has been lost).
2. All documents proving the reason for the application for reissuance.
Fee: None.

[PROCESSING PROCEDURE]
Application completed (Applicant) → Receipt (Ministry of Education) → Verification and examination of supporting documents (Ministry of Education) → Approval (Ministry of Education) → Preparation of certificate register and certificate (Ministry of Education) → Issuance of certificate (Ministry of Education).

Paper size: 210 mm × 297 mm; white paper (80 g/m²) or medium-weight paper (80 g/m²).
